mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when RSAFS declines > 1% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when INDPRO increases > 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a loosening monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and a decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3% MoM and PAYEMS declines > 100k MoM
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3% MoM and PAYEMS declines > 100k MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strengthening demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when HOUST increases > 5% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decline in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) coupled with an increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a supply-side shock and economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO declines > 1% MoM and UNRATE rises > 0.3% MoM
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO declines > 1% MoM and UNRATE rises > 0.3% MoM.
